page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; a diagram (globe with labels) in the centre; chapter heading and title below it; then one paragraph of running text with a drop cap. No notes in the margins. Right edge partly cut off by the scan.

main_text.p: [Diagram of a globe: Septentrio (top), Meridies (bottom), Occasus (left), Ortus (right); labels Dextra, Sinistra, Vmbra ortt., Vmbra occid., Vmb. Ortg, Vmb Occasg, Zona, torrida. Outline of the diagram, not transcribed as text.]
main_text.head: CAPUT X.
De Distinctione Partium terræ respectu plagarum Mundi ad se inuicem collatarum, siue de Longitudine ac Latitudine terræ & particularium in terra Locorum.
main_text.p: LEx methodi nos vocat ad distinctionem partium terræ respectu plagarum mundi inter sese, atque adeo respectu magnorum duorum circulorum, nempe Meridiani & Æquatoris:

page.notes: Diagram labels are partly damaged and read approximately; the right edge of the text is cut off by the scan, so the final words of lines are incomplete. The drop cap "L" is joined to "Ex" as "LEx". The final word "ris:" is printed at the right edge and is partly hidden.
